architecture.mechanism: Vortex‑induced shear from helical turbulator ribs creates secondary flows that continuously dislodge particles, reducing fouling while enhancing convective heat transfer, allowing higher heat recovery at low pressure drop.

architecture.expected_effect: Achieve ≥60 % sensible heat recovery from 40 °C wastewater (2 L/min) to 15 °C water while keeping the overall pressure drop below 10 kPa, with fouling rate reduced by >50 % compared to a plain tube.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct a 48‑hour bench‑scale test using a scaled‑down prototype with the helical rib design, measuring inlet/outlet temperatures and pressure drop; if pressure drop >10 kPa or recovered heat <60 % after the test, the architecture is falsified.
